meta.title: GlassDo — A calmer command center for your Mac
meta.description: GlassDo brings your tasks, notes, Edge Rail panel, and system status together in one calm interface, built exclusively for macOS.

hero.title: A calmer command center for your Mac.
hero.subtitle: Tasks, notes, and system status — right at the edge of your screen, one tap away. Without ever switching away from what you're focused on.
hero.note: Not on the App Store — download directly, set up in minutes.
hero.mockupLabel: Product screenshot: task list + Edge Rail + system metrics

items.title: Stay Focused
items.description: Your tasks wait at the edge of the screen; open and close them without ever leaving your main app.

items.title: See Your Mac
items.description: CPU, memory, disk, battery, and network — your whole system at a glance, with live graphs.

items.title: Capture Anything, Fast
items.description: Add whatever crosses your mind — a task or a note — in seconds, from the panel or the menu bar.

edgeRail.title: Edge Rail: a panel that lives on the edge of your screen
edgeRail.description: Rest it against any edge of your screen, open it on hover. Switch between the rail and the expanded view, tuck it away (sliver) or pin it in place — without the panel frame ever shifting.
points: Can rest against any screen edge
The frame stays put while you switch icons

tasksNotes.title: Tasks and notes, in one place
tasksNotes.description: Group by project or tag, add priority and due dates, keep multi-line notes. Smart lists — Today, Upcoming, All, Completed — help you find what you need instantly.
points: Notes you can pop out of the panel into free-floating windows

systemMonitoring.title: Watch your system in real time
systemMonitoring.description: CPU (per core), memory, disk, battery, and network speed — with live cards and graphs. Network speed tests and disk space analysis too.
systemMonitoring.privacyNote: This data never leaves your device.

widgetsMenuBar.title: Widgets and the menu bar
widgetsMenuBar.description: Today's tasks and a system summary in your desktop and Notification Center widgets. In the menu bar, whichever meter you want, in whichever format: bar, percentage, bytes, or graph.

privacySync.title: Sync, on your terms
privacySync.description: Your tasks and notes can optionally sync across your devices. Your system monitoring data (CPU, RAM, disk, network) never goes to the cloud by default — it stays on your own Mac.
points: Task/note sync is opt-in and scoped to your account
Anonymous usage analytics only contribute if you allow it

steps.description: Open the downloaded file in Finder.

installGuide.gatekeeperTitle: What will you see on first launch?
installGuide.gatekeeperDescription: This build hasn't been notarized by Apple yet; macOS may show a security warning on first launch. You can continue by right-clicking the app in Finder and choosing Open.

items.question: Why isn't it on the App Store?
items.answer: GlassDo uses system-level integrations the App Store doesn't allow (the Edge Rail panel, live system metrics, menu bar meters). That's why it's distributed as a direct download.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: Your tasks and notes are stored on your device (locally) first. If you turn on sync, only that data is stored in the cloud, tied to your account. Your system monitoring data is never sent to the cloud.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: Yes. GlassDo is designed to work fully offline; an internet connection is only needed if sync is turned on.

items.question: Which Macs does it run on?
items.answer: It runs on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, on macOS 26 or later.

sections.heading: Your tasks and notes
paragraphs: GlassDo keeps your tasks, projects, tags, and notes entirely on your device (local storage). This content is not sent to any server today.
Cross-device sync is planned as an opt-in feature; once it ships, it will only run when you explicitly turn it on and it will be tied to your account. This policy will be updated once sync launches.

sections.heading: Your system monitoring data
paragraphs: CPU, memory, disk, battery, and network measurements are processed and displayed only on your device. This data is never sent to the cloud.

sections.heading: Anonymous usage analytics
paragraphs: We ask for permission on first launch. If you accept, the following anonymous data — never including your personal content — is recorded: a locally generated device identifier that doesn't identify you, device model, OS and app version, country/language (from system settings only — no IP address is used), and daily launch count.
You can turn this permission off anytime from Settings. Analytics never affects the app's core functionality.

sections.heading: What we don't collect
paragraphs: Your IP address, name, email address, or location (GPS) are never collected, under any circumstances.
